evidence: In 2024, we launched an AI stock analysis feature on Futubull for eligible investors. In 2025, we expanded this feature to Moomoo.

We have established an intelligent risk control platform built on our proprietary algorithms, which is capable of analyzing different types, sources and stages of risks and providing margin ratio adjustment recommendations and early risk warnings.
We have also developed AI-based customer service function leveraging our data analytics and natural language processing capabilities.
Research and development expenses were HK$1,908.8 million, an increase of 27.8% from HK$1,493.6 million in 2024. This increase was primarily due to increased investment in crypto and AI capabilities.
Certain of our products and services incorporate artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and features, such as Futubull AI and Moomoo AI we launched in 2025
ai_positioning.summary: FUTU intègre l'IA dans ses produits de trading (analyse boursière, gestion des risques, service client) et investit significativement en R&D pour développer ces capacités, tout en reconnaissant les risques réglementaires et opérationnels associés.
